name: Why do you love me?
source:
A short romantic novel about modern relationships. We took some situations from life and tried to answer the question "why do people love each other?".

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2802790/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一部关于现代人际关系的简短浪漫小说。我们选取了一些生活中的情景，试图回答“人们为什么彼此相爱？”这个问题。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2802790/]Steam[/url]]
